map.北纬 30°、建筑高 H=30 m、目标日照 T=2 h、日期取冬至（太阳赤纬:
At 30°N with building height H=30 m, target sunlight T=2 h and the date set to the winter solstice (solar declination δ≈−23.44°):
Noon solar altitude angle = 36.56°; altitude angle at the edge moment (±1 h, hour angle 15°) = 34.66°.
Minimum daylight spacing D = 30 / tan(34.66°) = 30 / 0.692 ≈ 43.40 m, corresponding to a daylight spacing coefficient of 1.26.
That is, the front building must be at least about 43.4 m from the rear one, so that one hour of sunlight (2 hours in total) is guaranteed on each side of noon on the winter solstice.
map.太阳赤纬 δ 怎么取？: How is the solar declination δ obtained?
map.δ 随日期变化，春分/秋分约 0°，夏至约 +23.44°，冬至约 −23.44: δ varies with the date: about 0° at the spring/autumn equinox, about +23.44° at the summer solstice and about −23.44° at the winter solstice. It can be approximated by δ ≈ −23.44°·cos(2π·(N+10)/365) (N is the day of the year), or you can directly use standard astronomical values. Planning commonly uses the Great Cold day (around 20 January) as the minimum sunlight standard.
map.为什么要做方位角修正？: Why is an azimuth correction needed?
map.简单的 D=H/tan(高度角) 假设遮挡物在正南。实际阴影有东西偏移，北向投影: The simple D=H/tan(altitude angle) assumes the obstruction is due south. Real shadows shift east and west, so the northward projection = H·cos(azimuth)/tan(altitude angle) is the distance actually cast toward due north, which judges obstruction of parcels to the north more accurately.
